Multi-geography "closest provider" access choropleth, with full control panel

Source: R/access_choropleth_map_multi.R
mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map_multi.Rd

Same idea as mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map() but for SEVERAL geographies switchable in one map (e.g. county AND congressional district). Each geography contributes a drive-time shading, a supply shading, an optional coverage shading, a legend set, a hover-labelled access-desert overlay, and click-to-highlight; providers and the search box are shared across every geography. A collapsible control panel (top right) drives geography/metric/basemap selection, an optional zoom-to-ZIP box, a reset-to-CONUS button, geolocate, print, and a worst-access quick-list; state round-trips through the URL hash for shareable links.

Usage

mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map_multi(
  geos,
  providers,
  highlight_lookup,
  band_colors,
  band_labels,
  title_html,
  base_tiles = "CartoDB.Positron",
  dark_tiles = "CartoDB.DarkMatter",
  provider_fill = "#3b0a45",
  coverage_by_geo = NULL,
  band_counts_by_geo = NULL,
  centroids_by_geo = NULL,
  worst_by_geo = NULL,
  iso_union = NULL,
  zip_centroids = NULL,
  conus_bounds = c(-125, 24.4, -66.9, 49.4),
  provider_noun = "provider",
  aria_label = NULL,
  desert_tooltip = NULL,
  coverage_metric_label = NULL,
  centroid_label = "Analysis point"
)

Arguments

geos

Named list; each element a list with sf (carrying the mm_* columns documented in mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map(), plus optional mm_fill_coverage, mm_hover, mm_hover_supply, mm_hover_coverage), supply_pal, supply_values, and optional time_legend, supply_legend, coverage_pal, coverage_values, coverage_legend, desert. Names become the geography labels shown in the control panel. The first geography is shown by default.

providers

sf POINTs (mm_id, mm_label, mm_popup), shared across every geography.

highlight_lookup

Named list merging every geography's geo-id -> provider-id vectors (ids must be unique across geographies).

band_colors, band_labels, title_html, base_tiles

As in mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map().

dark_tiles

character(1): provider-tile name for the dark basemap option. Default "CartoDB.DarkMatter", toggled from the control panel's Basemap switch.

provider_fill

Fill colour (or a leaflet formula, e.g. ~mm_fill) for the shared provider markers.

coverage_by_geo

Optional named list (geography name -> HTML string); the control panel shows the entry for the active geography and updates it when the geography changes.

band_counts_by_geo

Optional named list (geography name -> integer vector aligned to band_labels); appended as counts to the drive-time legend for that geography.

centroids_by_geo

Optional named list (geography name -> sf POINTs); each geography's scoring anchor point, shown as an optional overlay toggle. Makes the aggregation explicit – e.g. why a large district reads a slow band even with a provider inside it, when the anchor point sits elsewhere.

worst_by_geo

Optional named list (geography name -> data frame with label, lat, lon, optional note); rendered as a click-to-zoom "worst access" quick-list in the control panel.

iso_union

Optional sf with a band column: nested drive-time union polygons (any set of bands; drawn widest-first, in descending band order), toggled as an "Isochrone reach" overlay. NULL omits it.

zip_centroids

Optional data frame with zip, lat, lon columns; powers the client-side zoom-to-ZIP box (embedded as a compact lookup, no external geocoder). NULL hides the box.

conus_bounds

Numeric c(west, south, east, north) used for the initial frame and the reset-view button (default lower-48).

provider_noun

character(1): singular noun for what a provider is, used in the isochrone-band labels (e.g. "Reachable within 30 min of a <provider_noun>"). Default "provider". A caller mapping a specific specialty passes e.g. "urogynecologist".

aria_label

character(1) or NULL: the map container's aria-label, for assistive tech. Default NULL, which falls back to sprintf("Interactive map of access to %ss", provider_noun).

desert_tooltip

character(1) or NULL: tooltip text on the no-access legend swatch. Default NULL, which falls back to sprintf("purple outline = no %s in range", provider_noun).

coverage_metric_label

character(1) or NULL: label for the "Shade by: coverage" radio button, shown only when a geography carries mm_fill_coverage. Default NULL, which falls back to "Coverage".

centroid_label

character(1): heading used for the centroids_by_geo toggle and its marker popups. Default "Analysis point".

Value

A leaflet htmlwidget.

A sibling, not a duplicate, of mysterymaps_county_access_map()

See the section of the same name on mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map() – this function is the multi-geography extension of that one, not a third, competing template.
